input: Scan and digitize all old family photo albums

gold.taskTitle: Scan and Digitize All Old Family Photo Albums
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to scan and digitize their old family photo albums into a digital format for preservation and access.

questions.title: How many albums and loose photos do you have?
questions.description: Understanding the total volume of physical photos helps estimate time, storage, and equipment needs.

questions.title: What resolution or quality do you need for the scans?
questions.description: Knowing whether this is for casual viewing, printing, or archival purposes determines the required DPI and file format.

questions.title: Do you own a scanner, or do you need one?
questions.description: Identifying available equipment determines whether the user needs to purchase, borrow, or use a professional scanning service.

questions.title: Where do you want the final digital files stored?
questions.description: Understanding the target storage destination — hard drive, cloud service, USB — shapes the organization and backup strategy.

questions.title: Should the photos be labeled, dated, or organized by event?
questions.description: Knowing whether metadata, file naming, or folder structure matters will define how much manual work is involved beyond scanning.

questions.title: Do any photos need restoration or color correction?
questions.description: Determining if damaged, faded, or discolored photos need editing will affect the tools and time required.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target completion date?
questions.description: A timeframe helps prioritize the workload and decide whether to do it personally or hire a professional service.
